messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Elevated 502/504 spike at API Gateway edge (ingress) — 12% error rate over the past 3m; triggered paging to #incidents and on-call. svc: api-gateway-edge-prod, affected region: us-west-2, likely client-facing.

sre-oncall: oncall here (paging). I'm looking at metrics now. Can someone drop the initial impact summary into the thread? :eyes:

ingrid: seeing cluster fanout failures from edge->backend cluster B. 502s correlate with TCP resets on outbound connections to backend pool b-prod (10.2.4.x). Latency for healthy requests also spiking ~200ms.

ingrid: quick screenshot of dashboard: ```Gateway QPS: 4.2k
502 rate: 12.3% (up from 0.5% baseline)
Avg latency: 260ms -> 480ms
Top error: upstream reset (RST) / connection timeout
```

dev-router: I pushed a routing rollout 35m ago that added new fanout rules for /v1/embeds -> b-prod canary. Rolling back now to baseline. Triggering rollback: `kubectl -n router rollout undo deploy/api-router --to-revision=4`.

sre-oncall: good. Start rollback but don't scale down yet; we want to observe for 2 minutes post-undo. Also open a temp failover to secondary pool a-prod for read-only routes. Dev-router can you add route override? If yes, add: ```route-override /v1/embeds -> a-prod (weight 100%)```.

dev-router: adding override. patch applied, propagation starting. CLI: `redwood-route patch --service api-gateway-edge --path /v1/embeds --backend a-prod --weight 100`.

leo: noted customer impact: a few customers hit 5xx when submitting batch embed jobs - CS has 7 tickets so far, highest severity S2 for one paid partner. Customer-success watching.

customer-success: contacting affected customers, offering retries and ETA. Escalated one partner to priority support, collecting logs and request IDs.

maria: checking backend b-prod logs. Seeing a spike of `max_conn_exceeded` and occasional OOM kills on host b-03. Looks like b-03 hit a leaked thread issue after the recent config tweak. Suspect the canary changed concurrency settings.

ingrid: aligns with observability: spike in keepalive resets to b-03 specifically. b-03 shows many 502 responses upstream. We should cordon b-03 and drain traffic.

sre-oncall: plan: 1) rollback router rollout (in progress), 2) patch router override to a-prod (done), 3) cordon+drain b-03, 4) scale b-prod down by 1 and restart b-03 if needed, 5) increase retry budget at gateway for idempotent calls for 2m, 6) notify customers.

dev-router: rollback finished at ~3641234578. Route override fully propagated from CDN edge at 3641234586.

ingrid: starting cordon/drain b-03: `kubectl cordon b-03 && kubectl drain b-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`.

maria: b-03 drained. restarting pod: `kubectl -n backend scale deploy b-prod --replicas=4 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/b-prod`.

sre-oncall: temporarily relaxing retry budget at edge: increase max_retries from 2 -> 5 for idempotent endpoints. Config: ```edge-retry-config {
  max_retries: 5
  per_try_timeout: 1s
  retry_on: 5xx,connect-failure,refused-stream
}``` Applying now.

dev-router: applied retry changes and reduced fanout concurrency to 50% for embed routes. Also disabling new header-based affinity introduced in rollout.

incident-bot: NOTE: a paging heartbeat at 3641234588 — incident classified as ACTIVE (mitigating).

leo: metrics update after rollback+override: 502 rate dropped from 12.3% -> 2.1% in 90s. Latency trending down to 310ms.

customer-success: updated customers; one partner accepted a manual replay of failed payloads and confirmed degraded UX but acceptable for now.

maria: b-03 restarted cleanly, memory stable. seeing no OOMs in last 45s. Will keep cordoned until we confirm healthy.

ingrid: recommending to reintroduce b-prod hosts gradually and monitor. Suggest we keep new routing rollout paused until we reconcile concurrency settings in config repo.

sre-oncall: agreed. Postmortem checklist: - keep incident open for 2hr to monitor - collect router rollout diff, concurrency params - gather failed request IDs for CS - prepare customer-facing blurb if impact resurges - schedule follow-up with router team and backend owners

pm-ash: thanks team. PM note: we need an internal blurb for status page (informational) and update runbook to cover header-affinity changes. I'll draft.

dev-router: root cause hypothesis: rollout introduced higher per-connection concurrency and header affinity that saturated b-03; also small memory leak aggravated load -> upstream RSTs. We'll revert affinity and add canary traffic shape tests.

sre-oncall: closing action items: keep route override for 10m, then shift 10% back every 2m while observing. If 502 > 1% at any step, revert.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 502/504 spike mitigated; error rate back to baseline. Final status: mitigated -> monitoring. Resolved at 3641234599. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: marking the thread resolved. I'll own the follow-up postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
